title: Ocean Fresh Canadian King Prawns Bake
description: A light and malty Canadian dish featuring king prawns, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this shojin-friendly recipe is baked to perfection on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together malt syrup, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the king prawns to the bowl and toss to coat with the malt syrup mixture.
Transfer the prawns to a baking dish and bake for 8 minutes.
Remove the prawns from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Return the prawns to the oven and bake for an additional 2 minutes.
Remove the prawns from the oven and let cool for 1 minute.
Serve the king prawns hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
